problem_statement: l2util_addr_from_str_sized() must parse a colon-separated hexadecimal address string into a destination buffer and return the number of parsed bytes, or 0 when the input is invalid or would need more bytes than the third argument permits. In particular, l2util_addr_from_str_sized('3E:E6:B5:0F:19:22:FD:0A', out, 6) must return 0. l2util_addr_from_str() must also return 0 for inputs that encode more than L2UTIL_ADDR_MAX_LEN bytes, without overwriting out[L2UTIL_ADDR_MAX_LEN].
